$comment: Template — copy to <tenant-slug>.json per tenant (architecture spine AD-2). Committed, versioned, diffable. No secrets here: DB URLs, Clerk keys, R2 credentials are deployment env vars, never checked in. androidPackageId sections must be [a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9_]* (Android/Java package id rules) -- hyphens from a tenant's slug/domain are not valid here, use underscores instead (verified against @bubblewrap/core's util.validatePackageId, the same validator infra/android/build.ts's --package-id flag runs).
